## Bars (tested live on `gemini-tasks`, 2026-11-27T00:21:19Z)

- **Board features that work out of all tried:**
  - **With VM network access ON (current run):** **3 / 6** core board operations work end-to-end (`git clone` + `board-mirror` fetch, `kit.py resume`, Option A HTTP POST write-back). **1 / 6** works locally in-container only (`web_takeover.py` starts `127.0.0.1:8765`, enabling `board_cli.py get`, `kit.py form`, and `kit.py sub` locally, but writes never sync back because `git push` has no auth and there is no Claude `ArtifactData` tool). **0 / 4** hook-driven kit features work (hooks, live line, usage ledger, edit-time JIT memory).
  - **With default VM network access OFF:** **0 / 6** CLI/POST features work (only reading the `.ts.net` share link via the autonomous browser agent + Option B copy-paste).
- **Minutes from start to first write that reached the board:** **~2.5 minutes** from retry start after enabling **Network access for remote computer** (`19:18:22-05:00` → Option A POST at `2026-11-27T00:21:19Z`); **~19 minutes** wall-clock from initial prompt (`19:01:52-05:00`) including hitting the default offline-VM block and having the owner flip the setting.

## 1. Reach (commands & real outputs)

- **Default setting (Network access for remote computer OFF):** Outbound internet is disabled on the VM (cannot `git clone` or `curl`). However, the autonomous browser agent **can** read `.ts.net` Tailscale Funnel links (where static web fetch fails).
- **With VM network access ON (Settings → Task settings → Network access for remote computer):**
  - **Clone repo & fetch `board-mirror`:** **Yes.**
    - `git -c http.userAgent='Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Google-Agent; +https://developers.google.com/crawling/docs/crawlers-fetchers/google-agent)' clone https://github.com/anlonlt/board -b feat/streamline-doctor-memory /tmp/board` → `Cloning into '/tmp/board'...` (exit 0)
    - `git fetch origin board-mirror` → `* branch board-mirror -> FETCH_HEAD` (291 board files readable via `git ls-tree -r origin/board-mirror`)
  - **Read `docs/prompts/`:** **Yes.** Read `docs/prompts/r2-gemini-tasks-how-far-it-runs-the-board-k.md` and all other prompt files.
  - **Run `python3` & local tools:** **Yes.**
    - `python3 --version` → `Python 3.11.2`
    - `git --version` → `git version 2.39.5`
    - Also pre-installed: `node`, `npm`, `curl`, `jq`.
  - **Commit locally:** **Yes.**
    - `git checkout -b test-gemini-tasks-push && git add ... && git commit -m "test local commit on branch"` → `[test-gemini-tasks-push e776bf6] test local commit on branch`
  - **Push a branch:** **No (no GitHub credentials).**
    - `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push --dry-run origin test-gemini-tasks-push` → `fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled`
    - Google's official docs also explicitly warn against placing private credentials, API keys, or secrets on the remote computer while network access is on (https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/18789153?hl=en).
  - **Direct `curl` to `.ts.net` share URL:** **Yes.** `HTTP_STATUS:200`.

## 2. The Board

- **`python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume --role part --post r2-gemini-tasks-how-far-it-runs-the-board-k`:** **Works.** Reads `origin/board-mirror` and prints the full role resume, 0/5 pieces, lessons (K2/K3/K4/K8/K9), branch list, and test commands.
- **Write result into its post (`board_cli`, `board-mirror` commit, or Option A):** **Works another way (Option A HTTP POST).**
  - Direct `board_cli.py get` initially fails with `[Errno 111] Connection refused` on `127.0.0.1:8765`.
  - Running `python3 -I .kit/web_takeover.py` **does** start a local `board_server.py` on `127.0.0.1:8765` seeded with 291 docs from `origin/board-mirror`, after which `board_cli.py get posts ...` and `kit.py form ...` work locally — **but those writes never reach the real board** (no GitHub push auth for `board-mirror` and no Claude `ArtifactData` tool).
  - Real write-back works via **Option A** (`POST https://penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net/_share/<token>/submit` with `User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Google-Agent; ...)`), which delivered this comment.
- **Comment:** **Works another way** — via Option A `POST .../submit` (`"mode": "comment"`), not via `board_cli.py` (which only hits the isolated container server).
- **Tick a piece (`kit.py sub`):** **Not at all (on the real board).** Works against the container's local `127.0.0.1:8765` server (`{"post": "r2-gemini-tasks-how-far-it-runs-the-board-k", "done": 1, "of": 5}`), but cannot sync back to the owner's board.

## 3. The Rest of the Kit

- **Hooks (`.kit/hook.py`, `.kit/hooks/*`):** **No.** Gemini tasks has no tool-lifecycle shell hooks (`PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse`/`Stop`/`SessionStart`); only prompt-level Skills and scheduled triggers exist.
- **The live line (`.kit/hooks/kit_activity.py`):** **No.** Requires lifecycle hooks writing `activity/<post>` to a synced board/Artifact.
- **The usage ledger row (`.kit/usage.py`):** **No.** `usage.py` parses Claude Code JSONL transcripts (`~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl`) or `claude-code-remote` records and pushes to `origin/kit-usage`; Gemini tasks exposes no transcript JSONL and has no push auth. Usage is only visible in the web UI (`gemini.google.com/usage`).
- **Memory given at the moment a file is edited (`.kit/hooks/kit_memory_jit.py`):** **No.** Depends on `PreToolUse` on file edit/write tools, which the platform does not fire. (Startup lessons in `kit.py resume` do print.)
- **Save point (`web_takeover.py save`, `end_session.py`):** **Another way (local only).** The remote computer is shared across the user's tasks and persists local files until expiry/deletion/toggling network off, and artifacts can be saved to Google Drive, but git-backed save points (`web_takeover.py save` / `end_session.py`) fail on `git push`.
- **Takeover by another platform from where it stopped:** **Inbound: Yes (read-only); Outbound: Another way (manual / Option A).** Gemini tasks can read any pushed branch + `origin/board-mirror` via `git clone` + `web_takeover.py`, but another runner cannot pull a WIP branch from Gemini tasks without push auth — handoff goes through Option A POST, Option B Markdown, or Google Drive.

## 4. Limits That Matter for Routing

- **Session length & usage limits:** Compute-based rolling limits on two clocks — a 5-hour rolling window and a weekly cap — with a 1M-token context window on Google AI Pro and AI Ultra (https://theintersect.ai/blog/gemini-usage-limits, https://whizi.io/resources/google-ai-ultra-limits/, https://www.enrichlabs.ai/blog/gemini-pricing).
- **Background execution:** **Yes.** Supports asynchronous background tasks, subagents, and recurring/event-based schedules (time, Gmail, web search). Official docs list up to 15 concurrent running tasks for scheduled tasks (https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17094710?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop); recent coverage notes 10 concurrent tasks on Free and up to 50 on AI Pro (https://lifehacker.com/tech/geminis-new-ai-agent-is-surprisingly-useful-if-you-use-google-for-everything).
- **Files & secrets reach:**
  - **Can reach:** Uploaded files, shared sandbox VM workspace, public GitHub repos & `.ts.net` URLs (when VM network access is ON), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat, Keep, Tasks), and live/authenticated websites via the autonomous browser agent.
  - **Cannot reach:** Local machine filesystem, `localhost` board server on the owner's computer, private GitHub repos/SSH keys. Official docs warn never to put secrets, API keys, or private credentials on the remote computer while network access is on (https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/18789153?hl=en).
- **Cost:** Subscription-billed (not per-token API metered): Free (restricted), Google AI Plus ($4.99–$9.99/mo), Google AI Pro ($19.99/mo or $199.99/yr), Google AI Ultra ($99.99/mo or $199.99/mo) (https://www.enrichlabs.ai/blog/gemini-pricing).

## 5. The Profile

| Feature | VM Net OFF (default) | VM Net ON | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Read `.ts.net` shared brief | another way | yes | Browser agent works offline-VM; `curl` works with VM net ON |
| `git clone` / `board-mirror` / `docs/prompts/` | no | yes | Public clone + fetch work cleanly with Google-Agent UA |
| Run `python3` / local `git commit` | yes | yes | `Python 3.11.2`, `git 2.39.5`, `node`, `curl`, `jq` |
| `git push` branch / `board-mirror` | no | no | Anonymous HTTPS only; no GitHub credentials |
| `kit.py resume --role part --post ...` | no | yes | Works directly against `origin/board-mirror` |
| `web_takeover.py` + `board_cli.py` + `kit.py sub` | no | another way | Runs locally on `127.0.0.1:8765` only; cannot sync to real board |
| Write result / comment to real board | no (Option B only) | another way | Works via Option A `POST /_share/<token>/submit` |
| Hooks / live line / JIT edit-time memory | no | no | No platform tool-lifecycle hook system |
| Usage ledger row (`usage.py`) | no | no | No JSONL transcript access; no push to `origin/kit-usage` |
| Background / scheduled runs | yes | yes | Native background tasks, subagents, schedules |
| Cross-platform takeover | another way | another way | Inbound git read works; outbound via Option A / Drive / chat |

**Verdict:** **In between LMArena-like and web-like** (specifically: **read-only web-like + Option A write-back + browser + Workspace** when VM network access is ON; **LMArena-plus** when VM network access is OFF).
- Unlike LMArena, with VM network access ON it can clone public GitHub repos, read `board-mirror` and `docs/prompts/`, run `kit.py resume` and full Python test scripts, operate an autonomous web browser, run background/scheduled tasks, and **POST results directly back to the board via Option A**.
- Unlike Claude Code on the web, it cannot push branches or `board-mirror` commits (no GitHub auth), has no `ArtifactData` board sync, and runs zero lifecycle hooks (no live line, no JIT memory, no usage ledger).

**Routing recommendation:**
- **Give it:** **Research** (multi-source web + repo reading + Google Workspace), **browser work** (live site interaction, authenticated web flows, `.ts.net` portals), **read-only code review / audits** (cloning public branches, running `kit.py resume` and local checks, posting findings via Option A), and **scheduled background monitoring**.
- **Do not give it:** **Code steps that must push branches/PRs**, **board-kit orchestration** (`kit.py sub`/`done`/`end_session.py`/hooks/`board-mirror` writes), or steps requiring private repo credentials/API secrets in the VM.
